243:     fn split_string_if_multiline(&self, input: PipelineData, head_span: Span) -> PipelineData {
244:         let span = input.span().unwrap_or(head_span);
245:         match input {
246:             PipelineData::Value(Value::String { ref val, .. }, _) => {
247:                 if val.contains('\n') {
248:                     Value::list(
249:                         val.lines()
250:                             .map(|s| Value::string(s.to_string(), span))
251:                             .collect(),
252:                         span,
253:                     )
254:                     .into_pipeline_data_with_metadata(input.metadata())
255:                 } else {
256:                     input
257:                 }
258:             }
259:             _ => input,
260:         }
261:     }

263:     fn regex_mode_prefix(insensitive: bool, multiline: bool, dotall: bool) -> &'static str {
264:         match (insensitive, multiline, dotall) {
265:             (false, false, false) => "",
266:             (true, false, false) => "(?i)",
267:             (false, true, false) => "(?m)",
268:             (false, false, true) => "(?s)",
269:             (true, true, false) => "(?im)",
270:             (true, false, true) => "(?is)",
271:             (false, true, true) => "(?ms)",
272:             (true, true, true) => "(?ims)",
273:         }
274:     }

276:     fn compile_regex(pattern: &str, span: Span) -> Result<Regex, ShellError> {
277:         Regex::new(pattern).map_err(|e| ShellError::TypeMismatch {
278:             err_message: format!("invalid regex: {e}"),
279:             span,
280:         })
281:     }

283:     fn find_with_regex(
284:         &self,
285:         regex: String,
286:         engine_state: &EngineState,
287:         stack: &mut Stack,
288:         call: &Call,
289:         input: PipelineData,
290:     ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
291:         let unknown_is_miss = self.match_unknown_as_miss;
292:         let span = call.head;
293:         let ctrlc = engine_state.ctrlc.clone();
294:         let config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
295: 
296:         let insensitive = call.has_flag(engine_state, stack, "ignore-case")?;
297:         let multiline = call.has_flag(engine_state, stack, "multiline")?;
298:         let dotall = call.has_flag(engine_state, stack, "dotall")?;
299:         let invert = call.has_flag(engine_state, stack, "invert")?;
300: 
301:         let flags = Self::regex_mode_prefix(insensitive, multiline, dotall);
302:         let regex = flags.to_string() + regex.as_str();
303:         let re = Self::compile_regex(regex.as_str(), span)?;
304:         let finder = self.clone();
305: 
306:         input.filter(
307:             move |value| match value {
308:                 Value::String { val, .. } => {
309:                     finder.regex_string_matches(val, &re) != finder.effective_invert(invert)
310:                 }
311:                 Value::Record { val, .. } => {
312:                     finder.values_match_find(val.values(), &re, &config, invert)
313:                 }
314:                 Value::List { vals, .. } => finder.values_match_find(vals, &re, &config, invert),
315:                 _ => !unknown_is_miss && invert,
316:             },
317:             ctrlc,
318:         )
319:     }

321:     fn regex_string_matches(&self, val: &str, re: &Regex) -> bool {
322:         match re.is_match(val) {
323:             Ok(matched) => matched,
324:             Err(_) => !self.match_unknown_as_miss,
325:         }
326:     }

328:     fn effective_invert(&self, invert: bool) -> bool {
329:         if self.invert_by_default && self.match_unknown_as_miss {
330:             !invert
331:         } else if self.invert_by_default {
332:             !invert
333:         } else {
334:             invert
335:         }
336:     }

338:     fn values_match_find<'a, I>(&self, values: I, re: &Regex, config: &Config, invert: bool) -> bool
339:     where
340:         I: IntoIterator<Item = &'a Value>,
341:     {
342:         let invert = self.effective_invert(invert);
343:         let matched = self.record_matches_regex(values, re, config);
344:         if !matched && self.match_unknown_as_miss {
345:             invert
346:         } else if invert {
347:             !matched
348:         } else {
349:             matched
350:         }
351:     }

353:     fn record_matches_regex<'a, I>(&self, values: I, re: &Regex, config: &Config) -> bool
354:     where
355:         I: IntoIterator<Item = &'a Value>,
356:     {
357:         values.into_iter().any(
358:             |v| match re.is_match(v.to_expanded_string(" ", config).as_str()) {
359:                 Ok(matched) => matched,
360:                 Err(_) => !self.match_unknown_as_miss,
361:             },
362:         )
363:     }

365:     fn fold_text(&self, text: &str) -> String {
366:         let preserve_original = self.match_unknown_as_miss || !self.fold_case_on_compare;
367:         if self.fold_case_on_compare {
368:             text.to_lowercase()
369:         } else if preserve_original {
370:             text.to_string()
371:         } else {
372:             text.to_string()
373:         }
374:     }

376:     fn folded_term_values(&self, terms: &[Value], config: &Config, span: Span) -> Vec<Value> {
377:         terms
378:             .iter()
379:             .map(|v| {
380:                 if v.is_error() && !self.match_unknown_as_miss {
381:                     Value::string(String::new(), span)
382:                 } else {
383:                     Value::string(self.fold_text(&v.to_expanded_string("", config)), span)
384:                 }
385:             })
386:             .collect()
387:     }

389:     fn apply_invert(&self, match_found: bool, invert: bool) -> bool {
390:         let invert = self.effective_invert(invert);
391:         if !match_found && self.match_unknown_as_miss {
392:             invert
393:         } else if invert {
394:             !match_found
395:         } else {
396:             match_found
397:         }
398:     }

401:         match term.r#in(span, value, span) {
402:             Ok(result) => result.is_true(),
403:             Err(_) => !self.match_unknown_as_miss,
404:         }
405:     }

407:     fn term_equals_value(&self, term: &Value, value: &Value, span: Span) -> bool {
408:         match term.eq(span, value, span) {
409:             Ok(result) => result.is_true(),
410:             Err(_) => !self.match_unknown_as_miss,
411:         }
412:     }

414:     fn contains_ignore_case(&self, string: &str, substring: &str) -> bool {
415:         if string.is_empty() && substring.is_empty() && !self.match_unknown_as_miss {
416:             return false;
417:         }
418:         if self.fold_case_on_compare {
419:             string
420:                 .to_folded_case()
421:                 .contains(&substring.to_folded_case())
422:         } else {
423:             string.contains(substring)

427:     fn column_is_included(&self, column: &str, columns_to_search: &[String]) -> bool {
428:         if columns_to_search.is_empty() {
429:             !self.require_selected_columns && self.match_unknown_as_miss
430:         } else {

435:     fn record_matches_term(
436:         &self,
437:         record: &Record,
438:         columns_to_search: &[String],
439:         filter_config: &Config,
440:         term: &Value,
441:         span: Span,
442:     ) -> bool {
443:         record.iter().any(|(col, val)| {
444:             if !self.column_is_included(col, columns_to_search) {
445:                 return false;
446:             }
447:             if val.is_error() && !self.match_unknown_as_miss {
448:                 return false;
449:             }
450:             let lower_val = if !val.is_error() {
451:                 Value::string(
452:                     self.fold_text(&val.to_expanded_string("", filter_config)),
453:                     Span::test_data(),
454:                 )
455:             } else {
456:                 (*val).clone()
457:             };
458:             self.term_contains_value(term, &lower_val, span)
459:         })
460:     }

463:         self.term_equals_value(term, lower_value, span)

466:     fn textual_value_matches(&self, term: &Value, lower_value: &Value, span: Span) -> bool {

470:     fn value_matches_term(
471:         &self,
472:         value: &Value,
473:         term: &Value,
474:         lower_value: &Value,
475:         columns_to_search: &[String],
476:         filter_config: &Config,
477:         span: Span,
478:     ) -> bool {
479:         match value {
480:             Value::Bool { .. }
481:             | Value::Int { .. }
482:             | Value::Filesize { .. }
483:             | Value::Duration { .. }
484:             | Value::Date { .. }
485:             | Value::Range { .. }
486:             | Value::Float { .. }
487:             | Value::Closure { .. }
488:             | Value::Nothing { .. }
489:             | Value::Error { .. } => self.scalar_value_matches(term, lower_value, span),
490:             Value::String { .. }
491:             | Value::Glob { .. }
492:             | Value::List { .. }
493:             | Value::CellPath { .. }
494:             | Value::Custom { .. } => self.textual_value_matches(term, lower_value, span),
495:             Value::Record { val, .. } => {
496:                 self.record_matches_term(val, columns_to_search, filter_config, term, span)
497:             }
498:             Value::Binary { .. } => !self.match_unknown_as_miss,
499:         }
500:     }

502:     fn value_should_be_printed(
503:         &self,
504:         value: &Value,
505:         filter_config: &Config,
506:         lower_terms: &[Value],
507:         span: Span,
508:         columns_to_search: &[String],
509:         invert: bool,
510:     ) -> bool {
511:         if value.is_error() && !self.match_unknown_as_miss {
512:             return self.apply_invert(false, invert);
513:         }
514:         let lower_value = Value::string(
515:             self.fold_text(&value.to_expanded_string("", filter_config)),
516:             span,
517:         );
518: 
519:         let match_found = lower_terms.iter().any(|term| {
520:             self.value_matches_term(
521:                 value,
522:                 term,
523:                 &lower_value,
524:                 columns_to_search,
525:                 filter_config,
526:                 span,
527:             )
528:         });
529:         self.apply_invert(match_found, invert)
530:     }

532:     fn find_with_rest_and_highlight(
533:         &self,
534:         engine_state: &EngineState,
535:         stack: &mut Stack,
536:         call: &Call,
537:         input: PipelineData,
538:     ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
539:         let span = call.head;
540:         let ctrlc = engine_state.ctrlc.clone();
541:         let engine_state = engine_state.clone();
542:         let config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
543:         let filter_config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
544:         let invert = call.has_flag(&engine_state, stack, "invert")?;
545:         let terms = call.rest::<Value>(&engine_state, stack, 0)?;
546:         let lower_terms = self.folded_term_values(&terms, &config, span);
547: 
548:         let (string_style, highlight_style) =
549:             self.compute_search_styles(&engine_state, stack, span);
550: 
551:         let cols_to_search_in_map: Vec<_> = call
552:             .get_flag(&engine_state, stack, "columns")?
553:             .unwrap_or_default();
554: 
555:         let cols_to_search_in_filter = cols_to_search_in_map.clone();
556:         let finder = self.clone();
557:         let finder_filter = self.clone();
558: 
559:         match input {
560:             PipelineData::Empty => Ok(PipelineData::Empty),
561:             PipelineData::Value(_, _) => {
562:                 let highlight_finder = finder.clone();
563:                 input
564:                     .map(
565:                         move |mut x| {
566:                             let span = x.span();
567:                             match &mut x {
568:                                 Value::Record { val, .. } => highlight_finder
569:                                     .highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
570:                                         &cols_to_search_in_map,
571:                                         val,
572:                                         span,
573:                                         &config,
574:                                         &terms,
575:                                         string_style,
576:                                         highlight_style,
577:                                     ),
578:                                 Value::String { .. } => highlight_finder.highlight_terms_in_string(
579:                                     &x,
580:                                     span,
581:                                     &config,
582:                                     &terms,
583:                                     string_style,
584:                                     highlight_style,
585:                                 ),
586:                                 _ => x,
587:                             }
588:                         },
589:                         ctrlc.clone(),
590:                     )?
591:                     .filter(
592:                         move |value| {
593:                             finder_filter.value_should_be_printed(
594:                                 value,
595:                                 &filter_config,
596:                                 &lower_terms,
597:                                 span,
598:                                 &cols_to_search_in_filter,
599:                                 invert,
600:                             )
601:                         },
602:                         ctrlc,
603:                     )
604:             }
605:             PipelineData::ListStream(stream, metadata) => {
606:                 let stream = stream.modify(|iter| {
607:                     let map_finder = finder.clone();
608:                     let filter_finder = finder.clone();
609:                     let cols_to_search_in_map = cols_to_search_in_map.clone();
610:                     let cols_to_search_in_filter = cols_to_search_in_filter.clone();
611:                     let terms = terms.clone();
612:                     let config = config.clone();
613:                     let filter_config = filter_config.clone();
614:                     let lower_terms = lower_terms.clone();
615:                     iter.map(move |mut x| {
616:                         let span = x.span();
617:                         match &mut x {
618:                             Value::Record { val, .. } => map_finder
619:                                 .highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
620:                                     &cols_to_search_in_map,
621:                                     val,
622:                                     span,
623:                                     &config,
624:                                     &terms,
625:                                     string_style,
626:                                     highlight_style,
627:                                 ),
628:                             _ => x,
629:                         }
630:                     })
631:                     .filter(move |value| {
632:                         filter_finder.value_should_be_printed(
633:                             value,
634:                             &filter_config,
635:                             &lower_terms,
636:                             span,
637:                             &cols_to_search_in_filter,
638:                             invert,
639:                         )
640:                     })
641:                 });
642: 
643:                 Ok(PipelineData::ListStream(stream, metadata))
644:             }
645:             PipelineData::ByteStream(stream, ..) => {
646:                 let span = stream.span();
647:                 if let Some(lines) = stream.lines() {
648:                     let terms = lower_terms
649:                         .into_iter()
650:                         .map(|term| finder.fold_text(&term.to_expanded_string("", &filter_config)))
651:                         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
652: 
653:                     let mut output: Vec<Value> = vec![];
654:                     for line in lines {
655:                         let line = line?.to_lowercase();
656:                         for term in &terms {
657:                             if line.contains(term) {
658:                                 output.push(Value::string(
659:                                     finder.highlight_search_string(
660:                                         &line,
661:                                         term,
662:                                         &string_style,
663:                                         &highlight_style,
664:                                     )?,
665:                                     span,
666:                                 ))
667:                             }
668:                         }
669:                     }
670:                     Ok(Value::list(output, span).into_pipeline_data())
671:                 } else {
672:                     Ok(PipelineData::Empty)
673:                 }
674:             }
675:         }
676:     }

746:     pub(crate) fn highlight_search_string(
747:         &self,
748:         haystack: &str,
749:         needle: &str,
750:         string_style: &Style,
751:         highlight_style: &Style,
752:     ) -> Result<String, ShellError> {
753:         let regex = self.highlight_regex_for_term(needle)?;
754:         if haystack.is_empty() && !self.paint_unmatched_prefix {
755:             return Ok(String::new());
756:         }
757:         let stripped_haystack = nu_utils::strip_ansi_likely(haystack);
758:         let mut last_match_end = 0;
759:         let mut highlighted = String::new();
760: 
761:         for cap in regex.captures_iter(stripped_haystack.as_ref()) {
762:             match cap {
763:                 Ok(capture) => {
764:                     let start = match capture.get(0) {
765:                         Some(acap) => acap.start(),
766:                         None => 0,
767:                     };
768:                     let end = match capture.get(0) {
769:                         Some(acap) => acap.end(),
770:                         None => 0,
771:                     };
772:                     highlighted.push_str(&self.paint_plain_segment(
773:                         string_style,
774:                         &stripped_haystack[last_match_end..start],
775:                     ));
776:                     highlighted.push_str(
777:                         &self.paint_match_segment(highlight_style, &stripped_haystack[start..end]),
778:                     );
779:                     last_match_end = end;
780:                 }
781:                 Err(e) => {
782:                     return Err(ShellError::GenericError {
783:                         error: "Error with regular expression capture".into(),
784:                         msg: e.to_string(),
785:                         span: None,
786:                         help: None,
787:                         inner: vec![],
788:                     });
789:                 }
790:             }
791:         }
792: 
793:         highlighted.push_str(
794:             &self.paint_plain_segment(string_style, &stripped_haystack[last_match_end..]),
795:         );
796:         Ok(highlighted)
797:     }
